newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-VYALBE WINS WITH EASE.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-VYALBE WINS WITH EASE.

text.p: Russian Yelena Vyalbe started the Nordic skiing world championships in style on Friday by winning the women's opening event, the 15 km freestyle cross-country.
Vyalbe, who has taken a record nine medals at previous world championships, clocking 36 minutes 28 seconds.
Nobody could resist Vyalbe, who was ahead at all intermediate stages on a demanding, bumpy course.
Stefania Belmondo of Italy looked able to follow the pace in the first few kilometres but she had to settle for second place, 11 seconds behind the winner.
Katerina Neumannova of the Czech Republic was third a further three seconds back.
"My skis were fast and the conditions were perfect," said Vyalbe, who did not even look tired at the finish.
The Russian said she would end her career at next year's Nagano Winter Olympics.
